channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Indian Rupee recovers strongly amid steep decline in oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its recovery against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy week.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Extended RBA pause may weigh on AUD – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad sees above-target Australian inflation keeping Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) hike risks alive, with June and Q2 Consumer Price Index (CPI) expected to show firm trimmed mean readings.

item.title: Iran’s Baghaei: Iran has not asked for resumption of talks with the US
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said during the European trading session on Monday that mediation efforts by Gulf countries towards the United States (US)-Iran diplomatic solution remain active, but Tehran is not having direct talks with Washington.

item.title: Euro: Energy risks cap recovery against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes that EUR/USD has rebounded above 1.140 on lower Oil prices but argues the move looks optimistic without a clear de-escalation in geopolitical tensions.

item.title: ECB’s Kazimir: One more interest rate hike is needed
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), Peter Kazimir, seems to be leaning towards a hawkish monetary policy outlook.

item.title: Gold stands firm on US-Iran diplomacy hopes, reduced Fed hike bets; bulls lack conviction
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) continues with its struggle to capitalize on a modest gap-up opening beyond the $4,100 mark through the early European session on Monday as bulls seem hesitant ahead of the crucial FOMC meeting this week.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: VCP breakout likely after Fed-BoE policy announcements
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.15% to near 1.3345 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Germany’s IFO Business Climate Index improves to 86.6 in July, beats estimates
item.description: The German IFO Institute Business Climate Index improves to 86.6 in July, higher than 86.1 estimates and the June’s reading of 85.7, revised higher from 85.6.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI inflow measures support against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts report that USD/INR was little changed near 96.57 on Friday but has edged higher since early July, largely reflecting renewed upward pressure from Oil prices. They argue that the recent pullback in Oil should ease some strain on the Rupee.

item.title: Forex Today: US and Iran halt strikes, boosting mood to start Fed week
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, July 27:

item.title: Oil: War risks keep prices volatile – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior Macro Strategist Benjamin Picton notes that Oil futures are lower after President Trump paused further strikes on Iran, reversing last week’s Brent surge above $100.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Hawkish shift needed to aid JPY against US Dollar – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) is widely expected to keep rates unchanged, but stresses that markets need a clearer tightening signal as the Japanese Yen trades near multi-decade lows.

item.title: British Pound: BoE seen on hold as risks linger – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists note GBP/USD edged up to 1.3326, with Gilts caught between fiscal risks from Prime Minister Burnham’s debut plans and the Oil price shock.

item.title: ECB’s Žigman: Central bank is committed to ensure inflation stable around 2%
item.description: The remarks from European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of Croatia's central bank, Ante Žigman, in an interview with Jutarnji List, released during the European trading session on Monday, signal that the central bank will remain vigilant about the intensity and duration of

item.title: US Dollar: Fed hold and data support – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects a hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) hold and a goldilocks-like United States (US) macro backdrop to keep the US Dollar (USD) supported in coming days.

item.title: WTI drops to near $82.50 as US, Iran pause strikes for potential diplomacy
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price opened at a bearish gap, down by over 7%, trading around $82.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday. Crude oil prices declined after the United States (US) and Iran paused strikes over the weekend, following two weeks of direct attacks.

item.title: Euro gains strongly against US Dollar on revival of risk-on sentiment
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.36% higher to near 1.1410 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday. The major currency pair trades firmly as the revival of risk-on market sentiment has diminished the safe-haven appeal of the US Dollar.

item.title: Equities: Earnings and Fed keep risk balanced – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s strategists note that global equities delivered a mixed performance, with the S&P 500 posting a second consecutive weekly decline even as semiconductor shares recovered. European and some Asian markets fared better, while US futures moved higher at the start of the week.

item.title: Oil: Mounting supply risks and price pressures – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Charlie Lay notes that Brent and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) have pulled back after sharp gains, but underlying risks to Oil remain elevated. Escalation in the Persian Gulf and potential closure of the Strait of Bab al-Mandab are seen as key threats to supply routes.

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecast: In a positive trend with bulls eyeing 0.8555 resistance
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has picked up towards the 0.8540 area against the British Pound (GBP) on Monday, after a mild pullback on Friday found support at 0.8530. The pair maintains the immediate bullish trend from mid-July lows at 0.8455, with bulls looking at three-week highs in the area of 0.8555.

item.title: Euro: September hike outlook offers support against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists highlight that EUR/USD slipped slightly to 1.1369 as comments from European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Gediminas Simkus suggested a rate increase remains more likely than a hold.

item.title: Japanese Yen gains against US Dollar at the start of Fed-BoJ policy week
item.description: The Japanese Yen starts the week on a positive note against the US Dollar (USD), but is down against its other currency peers.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Consolidates near 0.7000 as bulls await 38.2% Fibo. breakout
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest bullish gap opening on Monday and oscillates in a narrow band around the 0.7000 psychological mark through the Asian session.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds gains around 186.50 within rising wedge
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 186.50 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross is keeping a bullish near-term bias as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: Swiss Franc climbs as US Dollar falls on easing safe-haven demand
item.description: USD/CHF depreciates after five days of losses, trading around 0.8150 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens as Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo resigns
item.description: USD/IDR has recovered its losses from the previous trading day, hovering around 18,050 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps over 2% to near $60 on renewed US-Iran diplomacy hopes
item.description: Silver price (XAG) trades sharply higher near $60.00 during the Asian trading session on Monday. The white metal starts the week on a firm note as the pause in military aggression between the United States (US) and Iran has sent oil prices sharply lower.

item.title: United States Dollar Index falls to near 101.00 after US-Iran strike halt
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is losing ground after posting minor losses in the previous trading day, trading around 101.20 during the Asian session on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar bulls seem hesitant; downside seems limited amid weak USD
item.description: The NZD/USD pair kicks off the new week on a positive note amid a broadly weaker US Dollar (USD), though it struggles to capitalize on gains beyond the 0.5800 mark.
